confidence_notes: Overall low. Food and drink anchors come from mixed, partly dated sources (crowdsourced Expatistan figures, Almurakib, a Patagonia price guide, and mainland Argentina aggregators), and several are quoted in ARS with no reliable 2026 conversion. Beer is the most-sourced anchor. Cocktail and wine lean on relative pricing to beer, since no by-the-glass Ushuaia price was found. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for the July winter season; no booking pages or current listings were inspected. The FX figure (0.6720 for 2026-11-18) came from search-result snippets citing RBA data, which needed a second RBA-targeted search; the RBA page itself was not read directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: No direct peer city. Food and drink are priced from Ushuaia-specific data points and mainland Argentine tourist-town benchmarks, adjusted upward for Ushuaia's Patagonia premium. Accommodation is a holistic estimate based on Ushuaia's July winter tourism demand and general knowledge of comparable Patagonian towns.
